title: Chapter 303: Undead Attack Changping County
content:
Chapter 303: Undead Attack Changping County

Wang Shuo also called in the two strongest lords in the Nanshan Society, Liu Zhiming and Wen Yifan.

These two people performed well in these two battles.

Moreover, the lost troops were quickly replenished in the territory, which was still quite solid.

"Everyone, just now, I got the news that the undead commander, the bloodthirsty demon wolf, has launched an attack on Changping County."

"Lin County Magistrate, I hope we will leave immediately and go to rescue."

Xiaochi Town Bu Lanlanxiu opened her mouth and said to everyone.

Everyone was also shocked. The actions of the undead army were really fast.

It has been less than 5 hours since the two armies started fighting in the morning, and the main force of Changping County has been wiped out.

"Everyone, what do you think? Let's talk about it."

Wang Shuo saw that no one was talking, so he had to break the silence.

The current situation is a test for everyone.

Everyone is dying for others to survive, and few people can do it.

But if we don't go to rescue, if the undead occupy Changping County and free up their hands, then these small forces will be doomed.

"Everyone, the main roads to Changping County are now occupied by the undead army. I'm afraid it will be difficult for us to rescue!"

Wang Shuo finally understood the conspiracy of the undead army.

It seems that they still want to break through Changping County first.

Just when Wang Shuo and others were holding a meeting.

The bloodthirsty demon wolf also took the stage in person and launched a general attack.

As a general, his body was 10 meters long, and he jumped onto the city wall with all his strength.

He spewed out fire from his mouth, burning the defending soldiers in pain.

Further away, there were some long-range stone-throwing monsters, which were higher in level than those attacking Nanshanji, and naturally had stronger attack power.

In addition, there were countless skeleton archers, and hot rockets were thrown at the city wall wantonly.

Under the city gate, the undead giant rhinoceros took heavy steps, each step made a deep pit, and the ground trembled.

As for the melee skeleton soldiers, they adopted the tactic of stacking people. They didn't need siege equipment such as ladders at all. They just stepped on their companions' bodies and climbed up.

...

Those who attacked Changping County were all the strongest ace soldiers in the Burning Legion.

For a time, the four walls were covered with skeletons.

Lin Xiaodong finally felt a little panic in his heart.

The blow of the annihilation of the main force of 2,000 people made him seem to be 10 years older.

At this time, Lin Xiaodong still had 4,000 direct troops left, but the overall strength was more than one level worse than that of the 2,000 people.

Moreover, the defensive wall was more than 40 kilometers long, and the difficulty could be imagined.

Even if the soldiers sent from various places were added together, there were only 50,000 people.

The combat effectiveness of these soldiers was even weaker than the 4,000 people in Changping County.

It's difficult! It's difficult...

Lin Xiaotian was as anxious as an ant on a hot pot at this time, constantly urging various towns to send reinforcements.

Wang Shuo was also in a dilemma at this time.

Lin Xiaotian was somewhat kind to Wang Shuo, although it was just a few hearts of towns that were of little use to him, but at least it was a sincerity.

After discussing for a while, Wang Shuo saw that most people did not express their opinions.

So he said decisively: "Everyone, Changping County and we are in a relationship of mutual dependence. If Changping County is breached, we will be the next one, so we should unite and go to rescue."

"Mayor Wang is right. Since everyone has come here, they must not want to see Changping County destroyed. We should find a way to rescue as soon as possible."
